consumer: SystemSuspend main.cpp opens both sysfs attributes and passes the FDs to SystemSuspend. SystemSuspend.cpp reads two durations and line-separated wake reasons after each suspend attempt; its virtual-device fallback can block suspend if native control nodes are unavailable. Policy labels and grants the read access. Source compatibility is positively established; SDK suspend activation was not tested.
security: 55607d0a35a3 snapshots action names using kstrdup_const(GFP_ATOMIC), frees with kfree_const when clearing either list, preserves permanent names without allocation and falls back to the permanent unknown name on allocation failure. This prevents later print/sysfs reads from retaining driver-owned storage beyond IRQ teardown (native free_irq returns the name; virtio_pci frees its msix_names storage after free_irq). Native IRQ flow holds the descriptor lock during direct capture. The exported threaded helper requires the descriptor/action/name to remain live during the call; no new lock inversion is introduced. Capture remains disabled after cache initialization failure. cfa8849595ba uses wakeup_srcu, matching native wakeup_source_remove synchronize_srcu, initializes nonzero-capacity output and treats composed names as data with a constant %s format. Native wakeup event counters, PM return values, registration/removal and print_active SRCU implementation remain. Diagnostic clamps do not guarantee an atomic clock interval. Separate watchdog/BPF extensions are not finalized by this scoped review.
